quotes: We write insurance policies that cover homeowners, condominium owners and commercial residential buildings for losses that result from, among other things, catastrophes.

we provide personal residential insurance in fourteen eastern and gulf states and commercial residential insurance in three of those states. business_model.claim: As of December 31, 2025, the company had 357,275 policies in force representing $1.4 billion of annualized premium, comprising 345,121 personal residential policies, 3,059 commercial residential policies, and 9,095 commercial general liability policies.

business_model.claim: The company conducts its operations as a single operating and reporting segment.
quotes: We conduct our operations as a single operating and reporting segment.

business_model.claim: Revenue is generated primarily from gross premiums written, which comprise direct premiums from policies written during the period and assumed premiums, net of ceded premiums transferred to reinsurers.
quotes: Gross premiums written represent, with respect to a period, the sum of direct premiums written (premiums from policies written during the period, net of any midterm cancellations and renewals of voluntary policies) and assumed premiums written (primarily premiums from state fair plan policies), in each case prior to ceding premiums to reinsurers.

business_model.claim: For the six months ended June 30, 2026, gross premiums written were $735,187 thousand and net premiums earned were $400,817 thousand, with ceded premiums of $303,899 thousand.

quotes: We address reinsurance and loss costs trends in the property insurance sector through rates and inflation guard factors which resulted in an increase in the average premium per policy of 8.9% at December 31, 2025, as compared to the prior year .
